defects.title: Write rate limit is counted per URL path: `PUT` / `DELETE` on different `/items/{id}` are not limited
Requests rejected by body validation (422) or authentication (401/403) are not rate-limited
`429` response: no `Retry-After` / `X-RateLimit-*` headers, `{"error"}` format instead of `{"detail"}`, not documented in Swagger
An invalid rate limit value in `.env` (`LOGIN_RATE_LIMIT=abc`) silently disables the limit
Security events are not logged: failed authentication (invalid / forged token) and rate limit violations (429) leave no record

questions.question: There is no per-account limit or lockout: each additional client IP gets 5 more password attempts per minute. Is account lockout planned?
The limit key is `request.client.host` and uvicorn runs without `--proxy-headers`: behind a reverse proxy all users share one limit. How will the API be deployed?
